name: Phoenix (Jean Grey)
notes: Jean is the current host to the interstellar energy being known as The Phoenix. She is romantically involved with Cyclops and best friends with Storm.
attack_table_rider: TK Force applies on any 3+ (knock Prone or slide 0–6 squares)

powers.name: "Get Away From Me!"
powers.effect: The target and each creature adjacent to you are pushed 3 squares.

powers.name: The Phoenix Burns Away Lies
powers.effect: The target takes 1✸ ongoing and loses one point of Resistance, Save Ends. On a failed save, the target is Vulnerable 1✸ for the rest of the encounter.

powers.name: Wings of Fire
powers.effect: Deal 2✸ with no attack roll. Counts as rolling a 5 for triggering abilities, e.g. TK Force.

powers.name: Flyer
powers.effect: Become Flying as a Move Action. If Bloodied, you fall to the ground Prone.

powers.name: TK Force
powers.effect: When you roll a 3–6 on an attack, either knock your target Prone, or slide them 0–6 squares.

powers.name: Force of Nature
powers.effect: You may use a maximum of two of your Phoenix Encounter Powers (☬) per Encounter.

powers.name: Mental Block [☬]
powers.effect: Target cannot attack you and one other creature you designate on its next turn.

powers.name: "I am power!" [☬]
powers.effect: Create a 7x7 zone centered within R10. Each creature within the zone takes 3✸.

powers.name: Telepathic Push [☬]
powers.effect: Target immediately makes an At Will attack against a target of your choosing.

powers.name: Radiance of the Stars [☬]
powers.effect: Target is Blinded until the end of its next Turn.

powers.name: Enervating Torrent [☬]
powers.effect: All target's attacks are reduced by 2✸ (save ends).

powers.name: Telekinetic Shield [☬]
powers.effect: Trigger: When you are the target of an attack, negate all damage from that attack.

role_actions.name: Overawe
role_actions.effect: Target is Weakened (deals ½ damage, rounded down), Save Ends.

role_actions.name: Terrify
role_actions.effect: Trigger: When an Enemy moves, spend an Action Point to negate that movement.

role_actions.name: Enrapture
role_actions.effect: Save: Distracted / Blinded (see Radiance of the Stars) for one turn.

role_actions.name: Phoenix Flare
role_actions.effect: Make any green or purple attack, adding Burst 1, targeting all creatures in the zone.

role_actions.name: Reshape Matter
role_actions.effect: A 5x5 zone becomes Difficult Terrain (remove any Low Cover), OR Obscured one turn, OR 1 square becomes Full Cover.

role_actions.name: Rally
role_actions.effect: Spend 1 Action Point: Heal 4 HP. Regain one Encounter power.
